title: Trajectory-Aware Benchmark Subset Selection for Cost-Efficient Software Engineering Agent Regression Testing
title_zh: 面向轨迹感知的高性价比软件工程智能体回归测试基准子集选择
abstract_en: Autonomous software engineering agents (SWE-agents) automate coding tasks. Each agent update may require re-running the full benchmark to detect regressions and improvements, at a cost of hundreds of millions of LLM tokens per run, which makes evaluation a bottleneck. One solution is to evaluate only a subset of benchmark instances. Yet, simple approaches, such as random sampling or stratified random sampling based on past pass/fail outcomes, risk producing high variance and unrepresentative subsets. We turn to agent trajectories, the step-by-step record of the actions an agent took. We propose a trajectory-aware subset selection approach that replaces random sampling with deterministic selection based on trajectory embeddings. We first group test set instances by their test outcome in a recent full test run to preserve the historical pass/fail rate, then select the subset using the trajectory's embedding space. We evaluate 76 subset selection configurations, including random sampling, embedding-based selection, clustering-based selection, and hybrid shortlist-then-subsample strategies, across three regression scenarios: same-configuration reruns, model and configuration changes, and agent framework changes. Our best trajectory-aware method is the one selecting benchmark instances closest to the centroid of each outcome group in the embedding space. It achieves the lowest estimation error among all methods we evaluate. For instance, when evaluating a given agent version on a selected subset of 5% or 10% of the test instances, our approach reduces the average estimation error by 3--11% and the worst-case error by 4--11% relative to the typical draw and 38--46% relative to the 95th-percentile draw of the strongest baseline. Our results show that a 10% trajectory-aware subset keeps the median estimation error below 5% while cutting token cost by roughly 90%.
abstract_zh: 自主软件工程智能体（SWE-agents）可自动完成编码任务，但每次智能体更新通常都需要重新运行完整基准测试，以检测性能回归与改进；单次运行可能消耗数亿个大语言模型（LLM）token，使评估成为主要瓶颈。一种解决方案是仅评估基准实例的子集。然而，随机采样或基于历史通过/失败结果的分层随机采样，容易产生较高方差并导致子集缺乏代表性。本文利用智能体轨迹（trajectory），即智能体执行任务时逐步采取的动作记录，提出一种轨迹感知的子集选择方法，以轨迹嵌入（trajectory embedding）空间中的确定性选择替代随机采样。该方法首先依据最近一次完整测试的结果，将测试实例按通过/失败分组，以保持历史通过率；随后在各结果组内基于轨迹嵌入空间选择子集。作者在三类回归场景下评估了76种子集选择配置，包括随机采样、基于嵌入的选择、基于聚类的选择，以及先筛选候选集再采样的混合策略：相同配置重复运行、模型与配置变化、智能体框架变化。表现最佳的轨迹感知方法是在每个结果组中选择嵌入空间内最接近质心的基准实例，其估计误差在所有评估方法中最低。以测试实例的5%或10%作为子集评估指定版本的智能体时，该方法相较于典型随机抽样，将平均估计误差降低3%至11%，相较于最强基线的95百分位抽样结果，将最坏情况误差降低38%至46%。结果表明，使用10%的轨迹感知子集可将估计误差中位数控制在5%以下，同时将token成本削减约90%。
key_points_zh: 核心问题是完整回归基准测试消耗数亿LLM token，已成为SWE-agents评估瓶颈。
方法先按最近一次测试的通过/失败结果分组，再依据agent trajectory的embedding进行确定性选样。
最佳策略是在每个结果组中选择最接近轨迹嵌入质心的实例，优于随机、聚类及混合基线。
在多种回归场景中，平均估计误差降低3%至11%，最坏情况误差相对强基线降低38%至46%。
仅使用10%的测试实例即可将误差中位数控制在5%以下，并节省约90%的token成本。

llm_assessment.comment: This directly addresses the cost and reliability bottleneck of coding-agent regression testing with a trajectory-informed, reusable evaluation protocol.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作利用轨迹信息构建可复用的评测协议，直接解决Coding Agent回归测试的成本与可靠性瓶颈。
